title: Harness-Bench: Evaluating Agent Harnesses across Models and Realistic Workflows
description: Each configuration receives identical task inputs and initial environments in an isolated workspace, retaining its own prompting, tools, context management, and recovery behavior. Oracles score final artifacts; traces support behavioral and resource analysis (Figure 2).
author: XLCYun

images.caption: Evaluation pipeline for a sales-data cleaning task. An isolated model–harness run produces artifacts for module checks and safety gates. Three modules pass and reporting fails, yielding 0.79 when the safety gate passes.
